per_rule.rule: S_N must not be null (mandatory one-to-one join key)
S_N must be unique across the table
Every S_N in Cust_Bio_dirty must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N
Account_No must not be null (mandatory account identifier)
Account_No should be unique (flag duplicates for business clarification)
Account_No must be exactly 4 digits
Name must not be null
Name must be in Title Case (except for lowercase particles: bin, binte, d/o, s/o)
ID_No must not be null (mandatory government identifier)
ID_No must match Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one prefix letter (S/T/F/G), 7 digits, one checksum letter
Race must be one of: Chinese, Malay, Indian
Race must be in Title Case (Chinese, Malay, Indian)
Gender must be either Male or Female
Gender must be in Title Case (Male, Female)
Age must be numeric and parseable as an integer
Age must be between 13 and 120 (realistic service account age range)
Contact_No must not be null (mandatory contact field)
Contact_No must be a valid Singapore phone number (8 digits, optional +65 or 65 prefix)
Email must not be null
Email must contain exactly one @ symbol with no whitespace
Country must not be null
Country must be standardized to 'Singapore' (flag variants: SG, S'pore, Singapura, 新加坡, etc.)
Street_Name must not be null
Street_Name must be in Title Case (not all uppercase)
Postal_Code must not be null
Postal_Code must be a 6-digit code
Name particles must be consistent with Gender (Bin/s/o indicates Male; Binte/d/o indicates Female)
If Country is Singapore (in any form), Postal_Code must be exactly 6 digits
ID_No must match the corresponding ID value in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
Name must match the corresponding Full_Name in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N (accounting for case standardization)
ID_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
Email must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
